{{Top}} {{Character |type=Galactic Empire |image=[[File:Unit_Besh.jpg]] |name=Thurgos |homeworld= |birth=By [[18 BBY]]Thurgos was a student at the one [[Standard year|year]] [[Academy for Young Imperials]] at the same time as [[Zare Leonis]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' establishes that Leonis was a [[Imperial cadet|cadet]] in [[5 BBY]]. ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' states that the youngest [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Imperial Academy|Academies]] begin training [[Star Wars: Han Solo - Imperial Cadet|Cadets]] is "13 standard years of age." This means Thurgos must have been [[Reproduction|born]] at least thirteen years before, by [[18 BBY]]. |death= |species= |gender= |pronouns= |height= |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes= |skin= |cyber= |families=new |parents=new |partners=new |siblings=new |children=new |affiliation=*[[LRC-077|LRC077]]''[[Servants of the Empire: Rebel in the Ranks]]'' **[[Unit Besh]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Cadets, you entered this facility as children, and in a few short weeks, you will leave as soldiers. By the time you complete your training, you will be prepared to serve your Emperor. Today, we will test your strength and resolve. Are you ready to become stormtroopers?''"
"''Sir, yes, sir!|[[Commandant]] [[Cumberlayne Aresko]] and Thurgos, with the cadets of LRC077|{{Rebels|Breaking Ranks}}}} '''Thurgos''' was an individual who trained as a [[Imperial cadet|cadet]] in the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Academy for Young Imperials]] on the [[planet]] [[Lothal]] around five [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin]]. The [[cadet]] was part of [[Unit Besh]], one of two four-man units which made up the cadet squad [[LRC-077|LRC077]]. When Unit Besh and [[Unit Aurek]], the other unit in LRC077, were summoned to [[the Well]] training facility in the academy, Thurgos and another member of Unit Besh named [[Betancy]] were ordered by [[Taskmaster]] [[Myles Grint]] to not take part in the exercise and instead stand with [[Sergeant]] [[Currahee]] and Units [[Unit Cresh|Cresh]] and [[Unit Dorn|Dorn]]. Thurgos and Betancy's shoulders slumped when given they were given the order, but the cadets obeyed and removed their helmets before walking away from their squad. {{Char-stub}} ==Appearances== *''[[Servants of the Empire: Rebel in the Ranks]]'' {{1stID|Thurgos}} *{{Rebels|Breaking Ranks}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Thurgos }} [[Category:Cadets of the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified species]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
